avis.texte: I bought this device for one function, but I have found all of the functions to be very useful. I have a lot of these gadgets already, but I love all the functions in one device.

Its only been about 3 weeks but I can already see a difference in my smile lines and under eye lines. My skin also looks plumper and fuller, and Ive gotten compliments from others saying I look like Im glowing. I havent experienced any breakouts with this at all. Its a little tricky to follow at first, but if you download the app, it explains all of the different modes and is very helpful. Its worth the splurge and Im excited to see more results!

It does take a lot of time to go thru multiple functions so you'll have to devote at least an extra 30 min to your routine. Overall if you have the funds I think this is a great at home device to add to your routine in between more professional services.
So far I love it! It actually feels like I'm making an impact on my skin!

I've only been using each mode on level 1 but had to take a few days off after my skin became pretty dry. I have pretty sensitive, dry skin. Now that I'm not using it every day, I am seeing some awesome results! My skin looks plumper and my acne scars a bit less red.

Seriously, i mean it, this is a game changing device. I got it for Christmas and im so in love with it already. It really does boost absorption of skincare products my face feels absolutely amazing after using this device. The device is very easy to use, it has a power button and a mode button which is perfectly simple. The best part i think other than the modes and what the each do, is that this has led lights so its alao a form of led light therapy and you can change the led colors in the app and switch it up if you want to,the app itself is super cool and fun to be on. Within one week of use, my smile lines are a little less visible, my skin looks radiant, also i stopped getting acne and this took down the acne face if it is swollen, also this makes dark spots brighter and less noticeable. Im telling you guys. This is the best thing that i ever got as far as skincare goes and i truly love this device. Its expensive but worth every single penny! I would highly recommend this to anyone asking "should i get this?" The answer is yes yes yes get yourself one of these and change your skin for the better! If i could give this more than 5 stars I'd give it all the stars in the world.

I stare at a computer all day, face tight and eyes strained…and after using this (i use the full time) my face and eyes are relaxed and it helps soak up all the product i use with it. Big part of my routine and excited to try their all night masks! Great buy

Ill start with this is not for beginners. Read the directions, find the videos, put the work in that you need to for a device like this. There is only one mode i could see being used without too much thought and thats the orange or booster mode and my favorite mode. The green=microcurrent is a second fav because its straight forward. I cant say im too fond of the red=derma shot mode. Even on the lowest level it hurts. I felt it in my teeth going over my cheek tonight and not in a good way. I cant imagine it on the highest. Your products are dependent on what mode you want to use. Ive played around with my normal routine and tried other items that medicube suggests as well. I typically use rhodes whole line but i also tried medicibes collagen line with this. Also, you need the app if you want to access the purple light. You cant get to it without the app. Overall solid device and replaces almost all of my devices that got pushed to the back simply because it takes extra time and product to utilize. This is straight forward and works with my skincare routine. The only thing i wish it had was a heating feature bwcause its amazing when you wake up or at the end of the day in the cooler months. Thats just my preference.

Overall i am happy and would recommend.

avis.titre: According to FDA should be registered as a medical device
avis.texte: The product has received consumer complaints, including adverse events like intense facial nerve pain, skin irritation, and breakouts. A search of the FDA's device registration database shows no record of the Medicube Booster Pro being registered as a medical device.
